Nigeria currently has no active Ebola case following the evacuation of the a patient to Switzerland.

The patient arrived from East Africa few days ago and was stablised by medical personnel in Nigeria.

U.S. Ambassador, Leo Brent Bozell III says South Africa could end up like Haiti if it implements certain economic and land policies.

He also stated that South Africa can be like the US with the right policies.

Source: News Day South Africa.
